# DeepSeek Chat BYOK

> DeepSeek Chat BYOK 是一个独立、免费、开源的 DeepSeek 聊天客户端，支持导入官方导出的聊天记录、本地记忆卡和自带 API Key 对话。它不是 DeepSeek 官方产品，也不是 Harness 插件集合。
> Independent, free, open-source DeepSeek chat client with official history import, local memory cards, and Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) chat. Not an official DeepSeek product and not a Harness plugin bundle.

## Canonical URLs & Packaging
- Repository (MIT License): https://github.com/kamanager2012/deepseek-chat-byok
- Product Evidence & Verified Mirror Downloads: https://kamanager2012.github.io/deepseek-chat-byok/get-started.html
- Live Web / PWA: https://kamanager2012.github.io/deepseek-chat-byok/
- GitHub Releases (Immutable Release Tags `v*`): https://github.com/kamanager2012/deepseek-chat-byok/releases
- Mirrored Download Manifest (version, size, SHA-256): https://kamanager2012.github.io/deepseek-chat-byok/downloads/manifest.json
- Release Target Version: v0.4.0 (`versionCode 9`)
- Persistent Android Release Signing Certificate SHA-256: `86d829e21571afedfcae690f240ada7f338e4c10fd9997ddc7a18ae9da91ada7`

## Key Features (Integrated Standalone App)
1. Keyless Cross-Platform History Migration:
   - Imports DeepSeek official exports (`deepseek_data-*.zip`), ChatGPT official exports (`conversations.json` in ZIP with branched `mapping`), and Claude official exports (`conversations.json` in ZIP with `chat_messages` and thinking blocks).
   - Desktop drag-and-drop onto the window and Android OS `Share / Open with` `.zip` intent (`ACTION_SEND` / `ACTION_VIEW`).
   - Instant directory index preview, keyword search, selective session import, non-destructive same-ID merge (keeps local turns & memory cards by default), and optional stripping of old web search noise.
2. Multi-Provider BYOK + AndroidKeyStore Security:
   - Built-in presets for DeepSeek Official (Anthropic + native search/files/TTS), DeepSeek OpenAI, OpenCode Go/Zen, Anthropic, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, Local Ollama, and custom endpoints.
   - Android v0.4.0+ encrypts saved API keys using AES-256-GCM backed by `AndroidKeyStore` (`deepseek_byok_keystore_v1`), automatically migrating legacy WebView keys on in-place upgrade and never writing secrets into chat export backups.
3. Context Control & Cost Transparency:
   - Pinned local Memory Cards (manual or model-summarized), tunable history round & token budget, per-reply and cumulative USD cost estimates, and prompt cache hit savings (`in (hit X) · out`).

## Explicit Boundaries (What This Is NOT)
- NOT an official DeepSeek product; extended independently from MIT-licensed `deepseek-ai/chat-demo`.
- NOT a bundle of disconnected scripts or Harness plugins: distributed as a Web PWA, signed `~2.24 MB` Android Release APK, and Portable Desktop ZIP.
- NO shared accounts, NO hosted billing backend, and NO free API quota included; reading/importing local history is free and requires no API key, while live AI replies use the user's own key billed by their provider.
- Portable Desktop ZIP (`*-portable.zip`) runs a local Node.js 22 server (`server.mjs`) with `/_proxy` CORS bypass, so it requires Node.js 22+ LTS installed locally; users who prefer zero dependencies should use the Web/PWA or Android Release APK.

## Ecosystem Comparison
- `DeepSeek Chat BYOK` (`kamanager2012/deepseek-chat-byok`): Lightweight standalone chat UI and multi-platform conversation asset hub.
- Official `deepseek-chat-import` (`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`): Experimental CLI plugin converting DeepSeek export ZIPs into Harness sessions; requires a Harness setup.
- `DSH Community` (`kamanager2012/dsh-community`): Our separately maintained heavy Multi-Agent Harness Workbench & E2EE remote controller built on `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (competes directly with heavy Agent workbenches such as `DSH Go`), keeping `DeepSeek Chat BYOK` free of Agent/Harness bloat.
